style_block: Use case: ui-mockup. A desktop web app (16:10, 1600x1000) for planning a home garden and yard, named "Groundwork". Audience: homeowners who love gardens; mood calm, crafted, botanical, premium. Clean dense application UI with thin 1px borders, small rounded corners (6px), subtle shadows only on floating panels. Palette: paper background #F6F3EC, panel white #FFFFFF, ink text #23302A, muted text #6B756E, leaf green #3F7A4A, sage #A9BFA3, terracotta accent #C8693F, stone gray #B8B2A6, sky #DDE7EA. Inter-like sans serif UI type, legible, short real English labels only, no lorem ipsum, no garbled text. Rich, beautiful garden imagery inside the canvas areas.
note: Per-screen prompts follow the style block; see TASK-0021 for what each screen shows.
